_readme: R347 Lane A — the intentional-layering allowlist (≤10 entries). Law: an entry exists ONLY for provably intentional layering (a written reason each); anything that merely 'looks fine' or hides a defect is refused. The detector (scripts/qa/overlap.mjs) filters ONLY big-fixed findings whose element selector starts with an entry's match; text-on-text, fixed-over-text, clipped and overflow findings are never allowlisted. Entries are added by the lane that proves the case, never to recover a red run.

entries.reason: R313 D9 / R315 K-A4 — the page's own drafting frame: four 1px hairlines at the 7px viewport inset, aria-hidden, pointer-transparent (styles/shell/sheet-frame.css). It intersects ~95% of the viewport BY DESIGN (it is the border, not a cover) and paints no ink except the hairlines; the reference's own page frame is the same construction. Proven intentional: its 4 borders are the only children, border 1px, background transparent.
